input.summary: Delete Customer-payable liquidated damages for late payment; replace with simple interest on undisputed overdue amounts.
input.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer, and 15% of annual Fees per week of delay is punitive and could exceed the contract value. We have replaced it with customary simple interest on undisputed overdue amounts, consistent with the dispute-withholding right in Section 7.3.

ops.oldText: 7.7 If any invoice is not paid within ten days of its due date, Customer shall pay Vendor, as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to fifteen percent of the annual Fees for each week the invoice remains unpaid.
ops.newText: 7.7 If a proper, undisputed invoice remains unpaid thirty days after its due date, Vendor's sole remedy is simple interest on the overdue amount at one percent per month (or the highest rate permitted by Applicable Law, if lower) from the due date until payment. No liquidated damages or penalty is payable by Customer under this Agreement.
